host: stock macOS 26.5, Apple Silicon M4 (H16C assets)
source: find/du-style walk of /System/Library/AssetsV2/ on the harvest host (2026-08-01); raw scan .scratch/uaf_inventory.json (same walk). Table I of the paper is pinned to this dump.

conventions.catalog_files: each purpose_auto/ directory also holds <family>.xml and <family>.xml.purged; earlier directory-listing censuses counted these as entries (+2 per family), verified on all 11 walked families (bundles_with_catalogs = asset_bundles + 2 for every one)
conventions.bytes: sum of the per-file sizes the raw scan records for each bundle (its 'all_files' list): the bundle's regular files except *.plist/*.json/*.xml and files sitting directly inside SecureAssetData/. It includes the per-variant Restore cryptex DMGs under AssetData/Restore/ and the plaintext lora.part.bin adapters. The paper displays these byte counts in binary scale at one decimal, labelled 'GB' (e.g. FM_GenerativeModels 7.7 GB).
conventions.du_total: the raw scan's own 'total_size' field: a du-style recursive directory total over <family>/purpose_auto/ with symlinks resolved (equivalent to du -skL), stored rounded to two decimals of GiB (e.g. '10.34G' = 10.34 GiB). It is larger than 'bytes' by the files the payload filter omits -- metadata (.plist/.json/.xml) plus the files directly inside SecureAssetData/ -- and, dominantly, because each per-variant Restore DMG is counted a second time: SecureAssetData/ holds a symlink SecureMobileAsset.dmg -> ../AssetData/Restore/<variant>_Cryptex.dmg and the walk resolves it to the target, adding the DMG's full size again. Verified live (macOS 27.0.1, 2026-10): du -sk vs du -skL differ by exactly the DMG size on two sample assets (GM task asset 28,956 vs 57,628 KiB, delta 29,360,128 B = its DMG; CodeLM guardrail 432,948 vs 656,180 KiB, delta 228,589,568 B = its DMG), and SecureAssetData/ itself is small -- plists, TSS tickets, integrity metadata, and that symlink only, du -sk 148 KiB (GM task) / 232 KiB (guardrail) -- not 'large per-device encrypted content'. Per family the du-vs-bytes delta equals the family's DMG mass plus a few MB of metadata: FM_GenerativeModels 10.34 GiB du vs 7.74 GiB payload (DMG mass 2,789,212,160 B over 27 DMGs), FM_CodeLM 13.57 vs 8.98 (4,922,015,744 B, 3 DMGs), FM_Visual 4.31 vs 2.99 (1,411,383,296 B, 1 DMG). Do not mix the two conventions.

FM_Overrides.note: not walked in the raw scan; 93 directory entries per the earlier census, minus the two catalog files by the same +2 convention -> 91 asset bundles. Display size 5.8 MB (unreverified).

four_fm_families.note: 19.7 GB in the paper = binary-scale (GiB) display of the three walked FM families' payload sum (19.712 GiB) plus the 5.8 MB FM_Overrides display size; 210 asset bundles; 218 was the catalog-inclusive directory count. du-style totals for the three walked families: 10.34 + 13.57 + 4.31 GiB.

walked_11_families.note: the 11 families of the raw scan (2026-08-01). Table I's caption cites 207 bundles / 23.5 GB (payload convention) for these.

five_wider_testable_families.note: adds 66 files to the companion paper's CoreML catalog (61 -> 127 total)

listed_uaf_families.provenance: harvest-host family listing recorded in docs/FOUNDATION_MODEL_ARCHITECTURE.md (header '27 UAF families'; its per-family table sums to 351 catalog-inclusive entries / ~23.7 GB, so the header's own '348 bundles / 24.1 GB' does not reproduce from its table and is not used by the paper). Not re-walkable: the harvest host is gone; the 2026-08-01 walk covered 11 of these. Cross-check (2026-10-04): all 27 names confirmed present as UAF family directories on a macOS 27 host, which lists 31 in total.
